char_001.name: AutoTest Hero
species_traits: Retrospect: The caster may remove a number of Memory counters to reduce the DEF or SPD of a target in their movement pattern by that amount.
Intangible: The caster may remove a number of Memory counters to move through that many objects.
Possession: The caster may remove a number of Memory counters to control any entity whose level is less than half that.
Vanish: The caster may not be targeted, but they may not move either.
Unresolved: The caster may remove a number of Memory counters to increase their ATK/DEF/SPD by half that.
Haunt: The caster may remove a number of Memory counters to reduce a target's MP by twice that much.
type_traits: Hivemind: Allied spirits in the caster's attack pattern gain ATK/DEF/SPD equal to SPL until end of turn.
Nest: The caster may spawn a number of Insect tokens equal to SPL for a number of turns equal to SPL.
Mandibles: The caster may deal additional damage equal to SPL for a number of turns equal to SPL.
Swarm: Targets in the caster's attack pattern take damage equal to the caster's SPL for a number of turns equal to the caster's SPL.
Cocoon: The caster may increase their DEF by twice SPL if they reduce their ATK and SPD by SPL.
Pestilence: The caster may target an area where entities take damage equal to SPL for a number of turns equal to SPL.
species_passive: Lingering: If this spirit ends two or more turns with no Memory counters on it, they receive damage equal to half their ATK.
Phantasmal: Once per turn, this spirit negates damage dealt to it and gains a number of Memory counters equal to the damage negated in this way.
type_passive: Frenzy: If this spirit has no active effects in their attack pattern they lose MP equal to the number of spaces they moved in their last turn.
Evolve: This spirit gains ATK and SPD equal to the number of active effects in their attack pattern at the end of their previous turn.
char_001.description: Offspring of Rabbit and Leo, born in the cosmic weave.

item_0001.name: Chro Lightning Ring
traits: Material (Chrono): Foresight: The caster gains DIV for each combat and non-combat check performed by the caster while this effect is active and their SPD is increased by half DIV for a number of turns equal to DIV.
Materia (Thunder): Shock: The caster may double knockback by an amount equal to SPL for a number of turns equal to SPL.

item_0002.name: Rept Ethereal Armor
traits: Material (Reptoid): Imitate: The caster may use the target's Type rather than their own for a number of turns equal to MNF.
Materia (Ghost): Evil-Eye: The target has their ATK and DEF reduced by DIV and their SPD increased by DIV for a number of turns equal to DIV.

item_0003.name: Bast Psyc Talisman
traits: Material (Bastet): Nimble: The caster may increase a target's SPD by SPL while reducing their own ATK by SPL for a number of turns equal to SPL.
Materia (Psychic): Telekinesis: The caster may apply Flying and Knockback to a number of objects in their attack pattern equal to MNF.
